name: openact
description: An open source SaaS starter kit for Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2 and Durable Objects. It comes with a Projects app for Kanban, Gantt and calendar views.
author: MarketGrowth (https://marketgrowth.io)

scripts.dev: npm run sync && npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --local
scripts.dev:ai: npm run sync && npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run sync && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run sync && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run sync && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run search:setup && wrangler deploy
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run docs:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.docs.jsonc

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your [Resend](https://resend.com/api-keys) API key. OpenAct sends sign-in codes and project invitations with it. Verify the sending domain in Resend first.

AUTH_SECRET.description: A long random string. OpenAct uses it to protect sign-in codes. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

EMAIL_FROM.description: The sender for emails, for example `OpenAct <no-reply@yourdomain.com>`. The domain must be verified in Resend.

APP_NAME.description: The name people see in the app and in emails.

SIGNUP_MODE.description: `open` lets anyone sign up. `invite` lets only invited people sign up. The first person can always sign up.

ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS.description: Optional. A comma-separated list such as `example.com,example.org`. Leave empty to allow all domains.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: The name of your [AI Gateway](https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/). AI requests go through it for logs, caching and rate limits.

AI_PROVIDER.description: `workers-ai` (no key needed), `anthropic` or `openai`. For `anthropic` or `openai`, add the API key as a secret and set `CF_ACCOUNT_ID`.

AI_MODEL.description: The model ID for the selected provider.

TYPESAFE_MODEL.description: The Jev release for the topic check. Used only when the TYPESAFE_API_KEY secret is set.

TYPESAFE_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Another URL for the TypeSafe API. Leave empty for https://api.typesafe.ai.

AI_SCOPE_MODEL.description: Optional. A small, fast model that checks if each request is about the project. Leave empty to use the default for the provider.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID. Needed only when `AI_PROVIDER` is `anthropic` or `openai`.

DB.description: The D1 database for users, projects and tasks.

FILES.description: The R2 bucket for task attachments.
